name: Atishay Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Atishay Ltd is a IT Consultancy and Services company which provides customized software solutions for businesses[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AL is an Information Technology driven company that offers services to help government organization find smarter solutions, data management, software development, E Governance, retail fintech,  and the implementation of turnkey IT solutions. Company is a provider of business and knowledge process services and acts as a singular framework for identifying and deploying IT applications

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 68.7 days to 51.1 days
cons: Stock is trading at 4.16 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 10.8% over last 3 years.
